column1: # note: NEW_SORT_SWAP (bmglp 28ca0:28c) -- compare-and-conditionally-exchange on a 32-bit key with a 3-field record swap. Nothing is computed (no add/shift/mul on the key); two records are exchanged. FIELD_REPACK and CMP_SKIP both misdescribe it, and at 48.48% of BMGLP it is too large to hide under OTHER. It is a polygon z-sort pass.

# note: anarchy___ANARCHY 1100:271 is filed FIXPT_STEP, but its integer step comes from the borrow of sub + jb rather than from a shift of a fixed-point accumulator -- the same DDA algebra with the fraction kept as a residual instead of as low bits.
# note: antro__ANTRO 1000:15b2 is an LCG PRNG (mul32 imm, add imm, shr#15, and#0x0f0f). Filed FIXPT_MUL because the op tree is exactly mul+shift+mask; it is not fixed-point in intent.

# note: per-pixel out_8/out_16 loops (akm_zorl 3f0a, black/bliq e9, anjofly c88, boem 2455) are filed IO_POLL per the family definition ("in/out to a port in a loop"), even though the arithmetic around them is ADDR_SCALE-shaped. The port write is the per-iteration cost.

# note: the same LZ77 decompressor (getbits shl#1 / 16-bit refill / rep_movsb match copy / literal byte) recurs verbatim in 12 demos at different load segments. It is split into GETBITS (or REFILL where it is a called subroutine), COPY_BACK and the literal MEMCOPY path rather than counted as one loop, or it would be the only loop in several programs.

# note: bltdemo__SHELLVT retired only 8482 guest ops in its window -- it is the loader shell that launches the other BLTDEMO parts. Its hot code is a per-byte copy through a call plus DOS EXEC glue; there is no arithmetic in it, and its shares should not be read as demo workload.
